author: reek
body: Renders schematic sheets to a framebuffer. Draws wires, junctions, symbols, labels, power symbols, buses, and no-connect markers. All coordinates are in nanometers internally; the renderer applies a view transform (pan + zoom) to convert to screen pixels.

author: reek
body: Wire hop-over detection. When two wires cross without a junction, one wire is drawn with a small arc to indicate no connection.
